name: do-09-tax-prep
description: NDI's DO-09 AI Employee. Collects a filing period's invoices and receipts into a shared Google Drive workspace, reads each document, categorises it against the firm's tax chart, raises an exception for every discrepancy rather than adjusting one away, drafts Schedule C, a 1099-NEC summary and a 1040-ES worksheet, and assembles the package a tax manager reviews. Nothing it produces is filed, submitted or signed.
